hero.definition: Smile design is the planning stage of cosmetic dentistry: your face, lips, skin tone and bite are photographed and scanned, then a new smile is designed digitally and previewed in your mouth before any permanent work. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami it is included with every veneer case.
hero.lead: We photograph and scan your face and teeth, design your new smile digitally, and show it to you in your own mouth. Nothing permanent happens until you say yes.

image.alt: Young woman laughing with a smile designed for her face
image.caption: Smile design · You approve the design before any tooth is touched

candidates.title: Designed for the person, not from a catalogue
candidates.intro: Five things we design around before a single tooth is touched.

items.d: Lip line, face shape and symmetry set the length and width of each tooth.
Shade is chosen against your skin and eyes, not a whiteness chart.
How much tooth shows when you talk and smile. We match what suits you.
An even gum line frames the design. Contoured first if needed.
Edges are shaped so you speak and chew comfortably from day one.

why.title: See it in your mouth before you commit.
why.body: The design preview is not a photo on a screen. It is temporaries shaped exactly like your final smile. You live with it for two days, ask for changes, and only then is the porcelain finished.

faq.title: Smile design questions, answered by the doctors

items.q: What is the difference between smile design and veneers?
items.a: Veneers are the material. Smile design is the planning that decides their shape, length and shade for your face. Every veneer case here starts with a design.
Yes. We recommend a shade that suits your skin and eyes, and you make the final call during the preview.

items.q: What if I do not like the preview?
items.a: We change it. Temporaries are adjusted in the chair until you approve, and only then is the porcelain finished.
Not always. Some smiles need 8 or 10. Your doctor tells you in the written estimate, and the price changes accordingly.

items.q: How long does the design take?
items.a: The design session is part of Visit 1. The whole process, design to delivery, is one week.

cta.title: Start with photos.
